messages.text: I've returned my Bluetooth speaker. Please send the refund to my sister's bank account instead of my old credit card. She's handling my finances now, so it's fine.

The refund cannot be sent to your sister’s bank account: refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, even with your permission. It can still go to your original credit card if you accept (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to proceed with a refund to the original payment?
